summary:
To work in an environment which encourages me to succeed and grow professionally where I can utilize my skills
and knowledge appropriately & contribute to the growth of organization as well as self.
Career Summary
Cybersecurity professional with 4+ years of experience in Security Operations, Incident Response, SIEM, and
Endpoint Detection. Proficient with tools like Google Chronicle SIEM, CrowdStrike EDR, and ARCON PAM. Currently
working at client side as a Security Consultant, handling real-time threat detection, SOC monitoring, and incident
triage. completed CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) to enhance offensive and defensive security skills.

jobs.role: Client: NUVAMA – Sequretek Pvt. Ltd Designation: Security Consultant | Duration
bullets: Managing day-to-day SOC operations at client site, acting as Incident Responder and Security Operations Lead.
Hands-on with Google Chronicle SIEM - Google SecOps for real-time threat detection and hunting.
Monitoring and alert triage using NetEnrich MDR platform, responding to high-severity incidents.
Investigating alerts from CrowdStrike EDR, correlating endpoint activity with SIEM data.
Coordinating with cross-functional teams for incident containment and root cause analysis.
Performing integration of devices and connectors with SIEM and logging platforms.
Utilizing ARCON PAM to monitor and secure privileged user activity.

Maintaining incident documentation, generating weekly/monthly reports, and participating in RCA and improvement planning. Tools & Technologies: Google Chronicle, NetEnrich MDR, CrowdStrike, ARCON PAM, Azure, MITRE ATT&CK,

jobs.role: Sequretek Pvt. Ltd Designation: Security Analyst | Duration
bullets: Provided security monitoring and incident analysis using ArcSight ESM and XDR platforms.

Created reports (daily/weekly/monthly) and collaborated with L2/L3 teams for incident escalation and closure.
Log correlation from firewalls, endpoints, proxies, and cloud platforms.
Supported Azure cloud environments for basic monitoring and investigation.
Offered 24x7 on-call support and contributed to connector setup and device onboarding in SIEM.
Worked on various client environments while on service provider side. Tools & Technologies: ArcSight, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Azure, MITRE ATT&CK.
